goal: Repository-Selbstcheck darf ein per Symlink ersetztes Editor-JavaScript nicht als vollständiges internes Asset akzeptieren.

guide_delta.topic: Schutz des Editor-Skripts vor symbolischen Verknüpfungen
guide_delta.summary: Der Selbstcheck meldet symbolische Links anstelle des echten Editor-Skripts als Fehler; keine Änderung an Oberfläche oder Nutzerdaten.

direct_dependencies: Step 1: reject symlinked asset and add isolated regression; internal test gate before step 2
Step 2: document evidence and update release duty matrix; no unrelated product work
tests_required: GitHub targeted + governance CI at final PR head
tests_explicitly_not_run: real browser/visual gate: editor runtime and rendering unchanged
SQLite migration/recovery: no storage write paths changed
risks: symlinks intentionally rejected even when pointing to an existing internal file
non-symlink nonempty JS is not a substitute for browser or syntax validation
non_changes: no data persistence/schema or CP-03/CP-06 changes
expected_side_effects: symlink to nonempty editor script now produces ROT and exit 1
missing, empty and real regular file behavior remains unchanged
